# Wind Turbine Technician I: Revised Posting, Change Log and Social Graphic

## 1. Revised Job Posting

# Wind Turbine Technician I
**Northgale Renewables · Cedar Ridge Wind Farm · Full-time**

**Pay:** $31–$38 per hour, plus overtime during the maintenance season (April–October). Starting pay within this range depends on relevant skills and experience.
**Schedule:** Rotating 4×10 (four 10-hour shifts per week)

### About the role
Join the field crew that keeps Cedar Ridge's turbines running safely and reliably. You'll climb turbines, do maintenance and troubleshoot faults alongside experienced technicians. New to wind? We provide training, including paid GWO Basic Safety Training.

### What you'll do
- Climb turbine towers and work at height to inspect and maintain equipment
- Troubleshoot turbine faults and help return units to service
- Follow and give safety-critical instructions by radio
- Drive company trucks between turbines across the site

### What you need
- A valid driver's license (the site is about 40 minutes from town)
- GWO Basic Safety Training, or completion within 90 days of hire (paid by Northgale)
- Ability to follow and give safety-critical instructions in English over radio
- Ability to perform the physical demands below, with or without reasonable accommodation

### Nice to have
- A technical certificate, or equivalent hands-on electrical, mechanical or military experience
- Up to 2 years of wind industry experience

**You do not need a degree or any prior wind experience.**

### Physical demands and work environment
- Climbing ladders in towers up to 80 m tall
- Working at height in a harness
- Lifting up to 50 lb
- Working outdoors in heat and cold

### Benefits
- Medical and dental coverage
- 401(k) with a company match of up to 4%
- Paid GWO training
- Tool allowance

### How to apply
Apply at **careers.example.com/cedar-ridge-tech1**. For questions, email **recruiting@example.com**.

### Equal opportunity
Northgale Renewables is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply, interview or perform the job, contact recruiting@example.com.

---

## 2. Change Log

| # | Original text | Revised text | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | "Wind Tech Rockstar Wanted!" | "Wind Turbine Technician I" | **Accuracy / inclusivity.** Matches the official title so job-board searches find it. "Rockstar" is vague and deters some applicants. |
| 2 | "young, energetic guy" | "Join the field crew…" | **Legal.** This is an age preference (ADEA) and a sex preference (Title VII). |
| 3 | "Recent graduates are ideal" | Removed. Replaced with "New to wind? We provide training." | **Legal.** "Recent graduates" is a recognized proxy for age. The new line keeps the entry-level message. |
| 4 | "Bachelor's degree in engineering" | No degree required. Technical certificate or equivalent hands-on experience preferred. | **Accuracy / inclusivity.** Matches the HR leveling guide and widens the pool to trades and veterans. |
| 5 | "Native English speaker" | "Follow and give safety-critical instructions in English over radio" | **Legal / accuracy.** "Native speaker" is national-origin discrimination (Title VII). The real job requirement is functional radio communication. |
| 6 | "2+ years of wind experience" | Up to 2 years preferred. Training provided. | **Accuracy.** The leveling guide sets 0–2 years. |
| 7 | "Must be able to climb 80 m towers and lift 50 lb" | Full physical-demands list, plus "with or without reasonable accommodation" | **Legal / accuracy.** Frames these as essential functions under the ADA. Adds the harness and outdoor-conditions facts. |
| 8 | "Clean driving record" | "A valid driver's license" | **Accuracy / inclusivity.** The job facts require only a valid license. "Clean" is undefined and could screen people out arbitrarily. |
| 9 | "$28–34/hour plus overtime" | "$31–$38 per hour, plus overtime during the maintenance season (April–October)" | **Legal / accuracy.** The state pay-transparency law requires a good-faith range. The draft range didn't match this quarter's approved range. |
| 10 | "Work hard, play hard." | Removed. Replaced with benefits and how to apply. | **Inclusivity.** The phrase suggests long hours and a drinking or party culture, and tells candidates nothing concrete. |
| 11 | *(missing)* | GWO BST requirement, or completion within 90 days at Northgale's cost | **Accuracy.** This is a role requirement in the leveling guide. |
| 12 | *(missing)* | Schedule, benefits, site location and the application link | **Accuracy / legal.** These are the job facts. Some pay-transparency states also require a benefits description. |
| 13 | *(missing)* | EEO and accommodation statement | **Legal.** Supports compliance and invites accommodation requests. |

**Confirm before publishing**
- **Overtime terms.** Confirm that the overtime wording matches payroll practice.
- **State rules.** Check whether the state also requires an application deadline or a fuller benefits description.
- **Insurer driving standard.** If the fleet insurer requires a driving-record standard, state the objective criterion instead of "clean."

---

## 3. Social Recruiting Graphic (1080×1080)

The graphic is also a job ad, so it shows the pay range.

### On-image copy
- **Header:** NORTHGALE RENEWABLES · pill: NOW HIRING
- **Eyebrow:** CEDAR RIDGE WIND FARM
- **Headline:** Wind Turbine Technician I
- **Pay:** $31–$38/hour
- **Pay subline:** + overtime in maintenance season (Apr–Oct)
- **Checklist:**
  - No degree required
  - New to wind? We train you
  - Paid GWO safety training
  - Rotating 4×10 schedule
- **Benefits strip:** Medical · Dental · 401(k) match up to 4% · Tool allowance
- **Call to action:** Apply: careers.example.com/cedar-ridge-tech1
- **Footer:** Equal opportunity employer · Accommodations: recruiting@example.com

### Layout by zone
| Zone | Y range (px) | Content |
|---|---|---|
| A: Header | 0–120 | Wordmark on the left, "Now hiring" pill on the right |
| B: Title and pay | 140–520 | Eyebrow, two-line headline and pay block on the left. Turbine illustration on the right (x 700–1080). |
| C: Divider | 545 | Hill silhouette and a thin rule |
| D: Checklist | 560–800 | Four check-icon bullets |
| E: Benefits | 820–860 | Single line of benefits |
| F: Call to action | 885–965 | Full-width yellow pill button |
| G: Footer | 990–1080 | EEO and accommodation line |

### Visual direction
- **Colour:**
  - Deep navy background (#0B2A3C to #0E3B52 gradient) with white text, about 14:1 contrast.
  - Wind-green accent (#3DDC97) for the eyebrow and checks.
  - Signal yellow (#FFD166) for pay and the call to action, about 11:1 on navy.
  - No information is carried by colour alone.
- **Imagery:**
  - The mock-up uses a simple turbine illustration.
  - For the final version, consider adding a real photo of Cedar Ridge technicians in PPE, taken with their consent.
  - Show a mix of ages, genders and backgrounds, and avoid stock "young guy" imagery.
- **Typography:**
  - Use a clean sans-serif such as Inter or Atkinson Hyperlegible.
  - Headline 84 px bold, pay 64 px bold, body 34 px, footer no smaller than 24 px, so text stays legible on phones.
  - Use sentence case for body text.
- **Accessibility:**
  - Put the full details in the post caption as well.
  - Use this alt text: *"Northgale Renewables is hiring a Wind Turbine Technician I at Cedar Ridge Wind Farm. $31–$38 per hour plus seasonal overtime. No degree required, training provided, paid GWO safety training, rotating 4×10 schedule. Apply at careers.example.com/cedar-ridge-tech1."*
